metadata.scope: Inline spur gearbox housings, worm gearbox bodies, planetary carrier housings.

material_suggestions.use_case: heavy-duty spur and worm gearbox bodies
material_suggestions.notes: Good damping; rigid; heavier than aluminum.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined prototype or small-batch gearbox housings
material_suggestions.notes: CNC-machine from billet; no casting required.
PA12-CF for structural rigidity; use metal inserts for shaft bores.

standards_used.name: ISO 286-1 H7
standards_used.applies_to: bearing seat bores in gearbox housing walls
standards_used.note: H7 bore tolerance for bearing outer race press fit.

standards_used.name: ISO 4762
standards_used.applies_to: lid bolt holes around housing perimeter
standards_used.note: M5 bolts for housings up to 150 mm; M6 for larger.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Two-shaft inline spur gearbox housing (lower half)
main_features: hollow rectangular shell (outer minus inner cavity)
two shaft bore holes through side walls
bearing seat recesses coaxial with shaft bores
lid bolt holes around top perimeter flange
design_rules: inner cavity subtracted keeping wall_thickness on all sides
shaft bores on correct horizontal axis through side walls
bearing seats larger-diameter recesses around shaft bores from outside walls
lid bolt holes are vertical cylinders on top flange perimeter
validation_criteria: two shaft bores through side walls
bearing seats present around shaft bores
failure_modes: solid block instead of hollow housing
shaft bores placed at wrong Z height

constraint_checks.expression: two shaft bore cylinders through walls
constraint_checks.message: Gearbox housing needs two coaxial shaft bore holes.
